implemented.native_provider: Actual SearchBackend implementation over retained FileSearchOwner, checked aggregate session/entry/index-byte/OS-worker reservations and explicit base-dir policy.

limits: No independent native worker package build/install/removal/replacement or unchanged-host selection gate yet.
No new CLI/App Server/GUI/Browser/manager Launch runtime gate in this slice.
Resource accounting is not total RSS: traversal metadata, allocator/stacks, parsed patterns, shared-runtime bookkeeping and later client copies are separate.
Linux execution does not establish Windows/WTF8 runtime behavior; platform-specific path branches are not cross-platform proof.
No universal OOM recovery, interruptible filesystem operations or production-scale default budgets are claimed.
The native worker crate applied after this WIP and staged facade are outside these test and source scopes.
Subsequent real-worker integration exposed an unresolved first-error/close race (ClosedLease masking ResourceExhausted); the earlier 141 passing cases do not prove every typed-error race safe.
